config.description: The lighting engine. Computes every scheduled lamp's target from the clock and the ls_* helpers (block start times incl. weekend times: Day uses its weekend time on Sat/Sun mornings, Cosy/Night on Fri/Sat evenings and the night after, fade minutes, per-block own timing/light toggles input_boolean.ls_<room>_<block>_own_timing|_own_light (off = that block uses the House value), block virtual lights light.ls_<scope>_<block>, per-lamp block lights light.ls_lamp_<lamp>_<block>, used only while their store input_text.ls_lamp_<lamp>_<block> has own=true (switch.ls_lamp_<lamp>_<block>_override); for plug lamps own=true makes the store's on decide (they win over room and House), wake, and the override store sensor.ls_overrides: block:<area> forces a block, light:<entity> holds a lamp as set by hand, mode:sara = Sara Mode: in common areas (every lamp whose area lacks the label Private Room) Day and Cosy colours become pink [255, 105, 180] at unchanged brightness, Night untouched, fades blend to/from pink) and sends it. Dimmable lamps (label house_schedule) are only adjusted while on; plug lamps (label on_off) are switched at block starts. reason=tick only sends to lamps that are fading or just reached a block. Fades end at the block start and are sent as 60 s steps. dry_run returns the plan instead of acting. Every change outside a running fade (setting changes, overrides, lamp switch-on, block edges) is a 3 s linear transition. Non-tick runs resend their commands once after 3 s (settle pass) to repair Zigbee commands dropped in a burst. Rooms are not configured anywhere: every area holding a scheduled lamp is a room scope; its per-room helpers (ls_<area>_*) are optional and fall back to House when missing. Next-block rule (input_boolean.ls_ovr_next_block_on): an override (lamp hold, block override, Sara Mode) set before its scope's fade start is not cut at the fade start; during the fade the lamp moves from its current (overridden) state to the next block (each step covers step/time-left of the remaining distance, so the fade is linear from where the override left it), and the record is cleared once the block is reached. Post-wake Day hold applies only while the Night block the wake interrupted is still current (Night started before the wake), so a new evening Night block is never turned into Day. The wake fade (Night to Day after the alarm) runs only while the room is still in the Night block that began before the wake, so an alarm after the room has reached Day changes nothing.

sequence.note: Display only: mirror the effective block (override or schedule) into input_select.ls_<scope>_override so dashboards can highlight it. The engine never reads these selects.

sequence.alias: Display only: mirror Sara Mode (override record mode:sara) into input_boolean.ls_sara_mode_mirror so /house-lights can highlight it. The engine never reads it.

sequence.note: Next-block rule: overrides set before the scope's latest fade start fade out with the fade (see plan) and end once the new block is reached.

sequence.alias: Settle pass: Zigbee does not acknowledge commands and can drop one in a burst of instant changes, leaving a lamp on the old colour while HA shows the new one. Resend the same commands once after 3 s (not on minute ticks). Colour resends go only to lamps still on, so a lamp someone switched off during those 3 s stays off.
